Service guidance

Rotate your device for a wider view, or open the guidance below.

Before your appointment

Bring the documents listed in your appointment letter. Staff can help you identify alternatives if a document is unavailable. Arrive at the reception desk ten minutes before your appointment and tell the receptionist which service you need. You may bring a support person, request an interpreter, or ask for a quieter place to wait. If you need to change your appointment, contact the service desk using the details in your letter.
